## 490. Evolution read on the root (EL)

Board item EL, from the question how the theory reads degenerative formations, limited resources, the range of evolution and giving that waits on giving with forgiveness, and the direction that becoming and evolution are one theory in a broad sense ([the source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-31-evolution-and-becoming-one.md)). The design ([NOTE](../../development/el-evolution-on-the-root/NOTE.md), with part 4 in [WS](../../development/el-evolution-on-the-root/WS.md)) was reviewed in three lenses (65 findings, every one taken) and built in four rounds of scratch Lean, each module recompiled and read by an independent AI verifier; the landing texts were read once more, every finding taken. Six modules join the core as leaves, and no existing module changes. Moves into the owners' modules (`GrammarMap`, `MapInstances`, `KeepingWidening`) and one rename (`Web.degenerates_of_gone`, whose name says degeneration while it concludes an end) are proposed in `LineDegeneration`'s docstring, each on its owner's yes, after OU7's rebuild, which changes the same modules.

**Self-review.**
1. All six are leaves: each imports only core modules and the EL modules below it, nothing else imports them, and no definition of an earlier module changes, so only they and the root module rebuild.
2. No classical principle enters. Where a stronger statement would need excluded middle (an end from a horizon, a law inducing inclusion through every agreeing normal form), the module proves that equivalence instead of assuming it.
3. `LineageRegions` imports `SelectionShift` and `LineDegeneration` in place of the copies it held in the scratch rounds, so the core holds each law once; `Web.Restated` in `LineDegeneration` re-derives landed laws as labelled restatements, no result.
4. Not done: the items in Boundary, and the proposed moves and renames, which are the owners'.
